validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION confirmed independently of GEM. Two independent origins name and describe this exact project: (1) Dominion Energy's own dedicated project microsite (dominionenergy.com/.../west-loop-project; live URL now 404s -- retired after project completion -- so cited via its Wayback capture, last live-verified 2023-11-30): 'Dominion Energy Transmission, Inc. (DETI) has proposed the West Loop Project... 150,000 dekatherms per day... adding 5 miles of pipeline... 36-inch pipeline... in-service third quarter of 2021,' with facility-level detail (Beaver Compressor Station/Koppel Regulation Junction/Stitt Gate Site in Beaver County, PA; Carroll Compressor Station in Carroll County, OH). (2) EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects database, which tracks it as its own row across 5+ vintages (Jan2019 through Jul2021) under FERC docket CP19-26, operator 'Dominion Energy Transmission Co', 5.1 mi / 36 in / 150 MMcf/d / $94.2M / PA->OH, status progressing Applied(2019-01-03)->Applied(2019-10-18)->Construction(2020-02-21)->Completed(2021-06-09). Correctly classified: this is a genuine standalone FERC-certificated interstate expansion project (its own docket, its own EIA tracking row), not a system-level duplicate of P0176's much larger 'Dominion Gas Pipeline' network row (6,059 mi) -- it is one discrete loop/expansion segment of that same corporate system, which is exactly how GEM already models it (segment_name='West Loop Expansion Project' under the same wiki page). Fuel=Gas and Status=operating are both correct. Opened and read to exhaustion: the Dominion project page (Wayback), and 5 vintages of the EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook (Jan2019, Jan2020, Jan2021, Jul2021; also checked May2018/Aug2018, which do not carry this project, consistent with it not existing publicly before late 2018). Of the harvested wiki-citation pool (6 unique refs for this row after resolving the shared cite_note-eia-6 and cite_note-1 group refs), I opened all 6: the bit.ly link (Wikipedia mirror, general Dominion Transmission background, not West Loop-specific -- not cited here), the NYISO overview PDF (general system overview, pre-dates this project, not cited), the NPR Cove Point/LNG story and the We Are Cove Point opposition page (both about the unrelated Cove Point LNG terminal/opposition, not this expansion -- not cited for this row), the EIA data.php landing page (superseded here by the actual dated EIA project workbooks, which is what the citation's own footnote points to), and the Dominion west-loop-project page (used, via Wayback).

validity.recommendation: update Owner1 (operators/owners tab) from 'Dominion Energy' to 'Berkshire Hathaway Energy' (parent of the renamed operating entity); update Operator similarly (see the paired fills[] entries)
validity.researcher_notes: Owner1='Dominion Energy' / 100% is stale for this pipeline as it exists TODAY, and was already wrong on the date it entered service. Two independent SEC filings (both primary, both filed under Dominion Energy, Inc.'s own CIK 0000715957) establish: (1) 8-K dated 2020-07-06 (Ex-99.1, filed 2020-07-05): 'Dominion Energy Agrees to Sell Gas Transmission, Storage Assets to Berkshire Hathaway Energy... Assets covered by the sale agreement include the company's ownership interests in Dominion Energy Transmission [i.e. DETI, the FERC applicant/operator of THIS project per CP19-26 and Dominion's own project page]... transaction valued at $9.7 billion.' (2) 8-K dated 2020-11-02: 'Dominion Energy... announced that it has closed on the sale of the majority of its gas transmission and storage assets to Berkshire Hathaway Energy Company... effective November 1, 2020.' DETI (owner/operator of the West Loop Expansion Project) was explicitly named among the divested assets and closed with the first (majority) tranche, not the follow-on Questar Pipeline tranche that completed in early 2021. Per EIA's own tracked status, the West Loop Expansion Project did not complete construction and enter service until 2021-06-09 -- more than 7 months AFTER the Nov 1, 2020 ownership transfer. So at every point this segment has actually been 'operating,' its owner/operator has been Berkshire Hathaway Energy, never Dominion Energy. Confirmed the successor entity's continuity via SEC EDGAR full-text search: Berkshire Hathaway Energy's own 10-K/8-K filings (2023-2026 vintages) list 'EASTERN GAS TRANSMISSION & STORAGE, INC.' (CIK 0001936737) as a co-registrant subsidiary, alongside 'EASTERN ENERGY GAS HOLDINGS, LLC' (CIK 0001603291 -- the SAME CIK that filed the July/November 2020 Dominion-side 8-Ks as 'Dominion Energy Gas Holdings, LLC'), i.e. DETI's holding-company chain was renamed in place after the sale, not replaced by a new corporate family. This also raises a likely duplicate/rename question for TWO OTHER rows (not mine to fix, flagged as a cross_row_lead): P0176 'Dominion Gas Pipeline' (6,059 mi, still under the old Dominion name, LastUpdated 2023-08-11) and P3220 'Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage System (EGTS)' (6,437.38 mi, already under the new post-sale name, LastUpdated 2022-10-07) may be the SAME physical network carried under its old and new corporate names on two separate GEM rows.

validity.recommendation: reconsider Delayed=yes/DelayType=inferred -- no documented schedule slip found; recommend blanking both unless a specific delay is sourced
validity.researcher_notes: Every documented schedule milestone for this project lines up, and the actual completion beat the last publicly announced target rather than lagging it. Dominion's own published schedule (its project page): FERC application Q1 2019, FERC order Q4 2019, begin construction Q1 2020, in-service Q3 2021. EIA's independently tracked status transitions corroborate this timeline structurally: 'Applied' with docket CP19-26 already assigned as of the 2019-01-03 update (i.e., filed on or ahead of the Q1-2019 target), still 'Applied' as of 2019-10-18, 'Construction' by 2020-02-21 (consistent with a Q1 2020 construction start), 'Completed' as of 2021-06-09 -- which is Q2 2021, AHEAD of the originally announced Q3 2021 in-service target, not behind it. I found no FERC order date, no rehearing/extension notice, and no trade-press mention of a slip for this specific project in either source I opened. Delayed=yes with DelayType=inferred looks like a mechanical/dormancy-style default applied to this stale row rather than a documented finding (the row's own LastUpdated is 2023-08-11, well after the project's 2021 completion, so 'inferred' as a dormancy proxy does not fit a project that was already complete and operating by then). I searched for a second, disconfirming account (in case the plan changed mid-project) via the EIA vintages spanning the full construction window (2019-2021) and found no gap or resumed-'Applied'/reopened status that would indicate a slip.

Two independent SEC filings (the divestiture 8-K and the closing 8-K, both under Dominion Energy Inc.'s own CIK) support the ownership-chain history; the specific successor entity name is corroborated by a separate BHE-side SEC filing chain (different filer/CIK). cross_row_leads.facts: P0176 'Dominion Gas Pipeline' (6,059 mi network row) is very likely the SAME physical system as P3220 'Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage System (EGTS)' (6,437.38 mi) under its pre-acquisition corporate name. Dominion Energy sold its gas transmission & storage business -- explicitly including 'Dominion Energy Transmission' (DETI), the FERC-jurisdictional entity that operates this whole network -- to Berkshire Hathaway Energy, closing Nov 1, 2020. The renamed successor entity, per Berkshire Hathaway Energy's own later SEC filings, operates as 'Eastern Gas Transmission & Storage, Inc.' This is worth a dedicated duplicate/rename check between P0176 and P3220 (mileage difference 6,059 vs 6,437.38 mi may reflect different measurement vintages of the same network, or a genuine scope difference -- not established here, flagged for the owner of those rows).

See the P0176 lead above -- P3220's name 'Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage System (EGTS)' is the exact post-acquisition corporate rebrand of the same DETI system that P0176 still carries under the pre-sale 'Dominion' name; the two rows' LastUpdated dates (P0176: 2023-08-11 under the old name; P3220: 2022-10-07 already under the new name) are consistent with one row having been updated post-sale and the other not.

summary: P2630 (Dominion Gas Pipeline / West Loop Expansion Project) is real, correctly classified, and its length/diameter/capacity/cost/states are all independently confirmed (Dominion Energy's own project page + EIA); but Owner1='Dominion Energy' is stale attribution (DETI was sold to Berkshire Hathaway Energy effective Nov 1, 2020, before this segment even entered service) and Delayed=yes/inferred is unsupported by any documented schedule slip -- both flagged as concerns with sourced corrections, plus a same-network duplicate/rename lead on P0176 vs P3220.
